To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the propagation of an ultrashort laser pulse through a medium with resonances is a complicated process, which is determined by the interaction of the material with the laser field and the material’s resonances.

the spatial effect of laser propagation through resonance media was investigated by solving Maxwell-Bloch equation with finite difference method, and the results show that the pulse profile of a 2 π soliton would expand and split when the interaction intensity of the laser and material was increased.

laser propagating through resonance materials taking into account of the spatial effect is a soliton, and the soliton would no longer be the 2π soliton, its pulse form would expand, and its degree of distortion depends upon the intensity of interaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the propagation of ultrashort pulses in resonant media and the influence of spatial effects.
the propagation of laser pulse through resonance media taking account of spatial effect and the effect on the propagation of laser pulses in resonance media was discussed.
the propagation of ultrashort pulses in resonance media.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the propagation of ultrashort pulses is not only affected by material dispersion, but also by nonlinear effect.

the spatial effect is an important factor to the propagation of ultrashort pulses, and the spatial effect would cause distortion to the profile of ultrashort pulse propagating through resonance medium, the distortion would be stronger with the increasing of interaction intensity.

the laser propagating in a resonance media is a complicated nonlinear phenomenon and the propagation characteristics depend not only on the laser parameters and material parameters but also on the interaction intensity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the propagation of ultrashort light pulses in resonance medium is a complex process, and the spatial effect of light pulse should be considered in the study of ultrashort pulse propagation in resonance medium.
we have made some progress in the study of the spatial effect on laser propagating through resonance materials, but there is still a long way to go to the practical application.
the propagation of ultrashort pulse laser in resonance media was affected by the interaction intensity and the pulse form was changed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the propagation of ultrashort pulse in resonance media is a complex process.
the spatial effect of the resonance material can be ignored when the laser pulse propagating in resonance media.
the spatial effect is an important factor in the propagation of ultrashort pulse laser through resonance media.
